title: Document the phase harnesses in docs/tools.md; keep reports out of git; propose a scheduled CI run
description:
## Intent
Make the harnesses findable and keep them out of the everyday test run.

## Steps
1. `docs/tools.md` "Tests": both harness commands, how long they take, where the reports go, and that `cargo test --workspace` skips them (`#[ignore]`).
2. Make sure `renders/` stays ignored for the reports (no report files in git).
3. Comment on apricitus-1f0e91 (CI) proposing a scheduled weekly run rather than per push; the owner decides.

## Verify
`git check-ignore renders/link-drift-native.json` prints the path; `grep -n "link-drift" docs/tools.md`.

Commit: `chore(<this task id>)`.
